tools.name: api-health
tools.description: Checks Veracode API connectivity and validates the configured HMAC credentials using GET /api/authn/v2/principal. Call this first if API connectivity or authentication is uncertain.

tools.name: dynamic-findings
tools.description: Get runtime vulnerabilities from platform-based DYNAMIC analysis scans (auth/session flaws, authorization bypasses, CSRF, clickjacking, etc.). These are findings from scans already completed on the Veracode platform — this tool does not run a new scan. Do not use for local or pipeline scan results.

params.name: application_path
params.description: Absolute path to the application workspace

params.name: app_profile
params.description: Application name (auto-detected if not provided)

params.name: severity
params.description: Exact severity (0=Info, 1=VeryLow, 2=Low, 3=Med, 4=High, 5=VeryHigh)

params.name: severity_gte
params.description: Minimum severity (0-5)

params.name: cwe_ids
params.description: Filter by CWE IDs (e.g., [89, 79] for SQLi and XSS)

params.name: page_size
params.description: Findings per page (1-500, default 10)

params.name: page
params.description: Page number (0-based, default 0)

params.name: violates_policy
params.description: Filter by policy violation status. Default is true (policy violations only). Only set this parameter if the user explicitly asks to see all findings regardless of policy. Do not set it to false unless directly requested.

tools.name: static-findings
tools.description: Get source code vulnerabilities from platform-based STATIC analysis scans on the Veracode platform (XSS, SQLi, crypto issues, buffer overflows, etc.). These are findings from scans already completed on the platform — this tool does not run a new scan. Do not use for local pipeline scan results; use pipeline-findings for those.

params.name: application_path
params.description: Absolute path to the application workspace

params.name: app_profile
params.description: Application name (auto-detected if not provided)

params.name: severity
params.description: Exact severity (0=Info, 1=VeryLow, 2=Low, 3=Med, 4=High, 5=VeryHigh)

params.name: severity_gte
params.description: Minimum severity (0-5)

params.name: cwe_ids
params.description: Filter by CWE IDs (e.g., [89, 79] for SQLi and XSS)

params.name: page_size
params.description: Findings per page (1-500, default 10)

params.name: page
params.description: Page number (0-based, default 0)

params.name: violates_policy
params.description: Filter by policy violation status. Default is true (policy violations only). Only set this parameter if the user explicitly asks to see all findings regardless of policy. Do not set it to false unless directly requested.

tools.name: finding-details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific flaw including full data-flow paths (SAST) or request/response info (DAST). Determines scan type automatically from flaw ID format: plain numeric (e.g., '12345') indicates a platform scan flaw; numeric with occurrence suffix (e.g., '12345-1') indicates a pipeline scan flaw. Use selectively for findings where the full data-flow path would materially change the remediation approach — not for every finding.

params.name: application_path
params.description: Absolute path to the application workspace

params.name: app_profile
params.description: Application name (auto-detected if not provided). Only used for platform scans.

params.name: flaw_id
params.description: Flaw ID to retrieve. Format: '1234' for platform scans, '1234-1' for pipeline scans with occurrence number.

tools.name: sca-findings
tools.description: Get third-party library vulnerabilities from platform-based SCA scans on the Veracode platform (vulnerable dependencies, outdated libraries, CVEs). These are findings from scans already completed on the platform. Do not use for local SCA scan results — use local-sca-findings for those.

params.name: application_path
params.description: Absolute path to the application workspace

params.name: app_profile
params.description: Application name (auto-detected if not provided)

params.name: severity
params.description: Exact severity (0=Info, 1=VeryLow, 2=Low, 3=Med, 4=High, 5=VeryHigh)

params.name: severity_gte
params.description: Minimum severity (0-5)

params.name: page_size
params.description: Findings per page (1-500, default 10)

params.name: page
params.description: Page number (0-based, default 0)

tools.name: package-workspace
tools.description: Packages source code into a ZIP artifact suitable for Veracode pipeline scanning. Must be called before pipeline-scan. Stores the artifact in .veracode/packaging/ within user's temp folder. If a filename is not specified, pipeline-scan will automatically locate the artifact.

params.name: application_path
params.description: Absolute path to the application workspace

params.name: filename
params.description: Output filename (saved to .veracode/packaging in the temp folder if no path specified)

tools.name: pipeline-scan
tools.description: Performs a local SAST scan using the Veracode Pipeline Scanner. Requires package-workspace to have been called first. This is a task-augmented tool (MCP Tasks, spec 2025-11-25): calls must include a "task" param; the server returns a CreateTaskResult immediately, then the scan runs in the background. Poll tasks/get for status, tasks/result for the final outcome, and tasks/cancel to abort a running scan. After completion, use pipeline-findings to retrieve results.

params.name: application_path
params.description: Absolute path to the application workspace

params.name: app_profile
params.description: Application name (auto-detected if not provided)

params.name: filename
params.description: File to scan (defaults to largest non-log file in .veracode/packaging in the temp folder)

tools.name: pipeline-findings
tools.description: Retrieves findings from a pipeline scan run via this toolset's pipeline-scan tool (auto-locates its most recent output by timestamp). Does not read results from scans run outside this toolset — if you already have a results.json from a separately-invoked scan, parse it directly instead of calling this tool.

params.name: application_path
params.description: Absolute path to the application workspace

params.name: violates_policy
params.description: Filter by policy violation status. Default is true (policy violations only). Only set this parameter if the user explicitly asks to see all findings regardless of policy. Do not set it to false unless directly requested.

params.name: cwe_ids
params.description: Filter by CWE IDs (e.g., [89, 79] for SQLi and XSS)

params.name: page_size
params.description: Findings per page (1-500, default 10)

params.name: page
params.description: Page number (0-based, default 0)

tools.name: local-sca-scan
tools.description: Runs a local SCA scan to identify vulnerable third-party dependencies and IaC misconfigurations. Stores results in the workspace. After completion, call local-sca-summary to retrieve dependency vulnerabilities and local-iac-findings to retrieve IaC misconfigurations — both read from the same scan output.

params.name: application_path
params.description: Absolute path to the application workspace

tools.name: local-sca-summary
tools.description: Groups local SCA scan findings by component to show the minimum version to upgrade each dependency to in order to fix all its CVEs. Use this for a remediation-focused view: which libraries to upgrade and to what version. Requires a prior local-sca-scan to have run.

params.name: application_path
params.description: Absolute path to the application workspace

params.name: severity_gte
params.description: Only include CVEs at or above this severity (2=Low, 3=Medium, 4=High, 5=Critical)

params.name: page_size
params.description: Components per page (1-500, default 20)

params.name: page
params.description: Page number (0-based, default 0)

tools.name: local-sca-findings
tools.description: Retrieves vulnerability details from a completed local SCA scan, including CVE identifiers, CVSS scores, EPSS scores, affected versions, and fix version recommendations. Requires a prior local-sca-scan to have run. EPSS score reflects real-world exploitability probability — prioritize findings with EPSS > 0.1 even for medium CVSS scores. Use the cve filter to look up a specific CVE directly.

params.name: application_path
params.description: Absolute path to the application workspace

params.name: cve
params.description: Filter by specific CVE ID (e.g., CVE-2024-1234)

params.name: component_name
params.description: Filter by library or component name (partial match, case-insensitive)

params.name: severity_gte
params.description: Minimum severity (2=Low, 3=Medium, 4=High, 5=Critical)

params.name: page_size
params.description: Findings per page (1-500, default 10)

params.name: page
params.description: Page number (0-based, default 0)

tools.name: local-iac-findings
tools.description: Retrieves IaC misconfiguration findings (Dockerfiles, Kubernetes manifests, cloud configs) from the most recent local SCA scan. Results come from the same scan run as local-sca-findings — run local-sca-scan once to populate both. By default returns only failed checks.

params.name: application_path
params.description: Absolute path to the application workspace

params.name: target
params.description: Filter by target file path (partial match, case-insensitive, e.g. 'Dockerfile')

params.name: check_id
params.description: Filter by specific check ID (e.g., DS026)

params.name: severity_gte
params.description: Minimum severity (2=Low, 3=Medium, 4=High, 5=Critical)

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by status: 'fail' (default), 'pass', or 'all'.  Only set this parameter if the user explicitly asks to see all findings regardless status.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Findings per page (1-500, default 10)

params.name: page
params.description: Page number (0-based, default 0)
